docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An American political theorist's case that democracy must be built from the groups in which people actually live and work.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Mary Parker Follett (1868–1933), The New State: Group Organization the Solution of Popular Government, 1918. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
